login.title: Log in to {app}
login.lead: Enter your phone number — we’ll show you a 4-digit code. No password needed.
login.phoneHint: If you already book on {brand} as a client, use that number — one account works for both.
login.incomplete: The number is incomplete — it needs {digits} digits.
login.notMobile: Codes go to mobile numbers only. Enter a number starting with {starts}.
login.tooManyCodes: Too many codes. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
login.codeHint: It checks itself after the 4th digit.
login.codeExpired: The old code no longer works.
login.wrongCode: Wrong code. {left, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
login.locked: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.

identity.title: Is this you, {name}?
identity.lead: This number’s account hasn’t been used for 6 months. Numbers sometimes pass to someone new, so we ask before you go in.
identity.ownsWorkspace: This account owns a business on {brand}, so it can’t start afresh here. Contact {brand} to sort out the number.

name.title: What’s your name?
name.lead: Your number is verified. Enter your name for your {brand} account — your team will see you by this name.

invite.title: {business} invites you to the team
invite.as: As {level, select, admin {an Admin} other {a Specialist}}
invite.admin1: You’ll see every calendar, booking and client
invite.admin2: You can answer requests and reply to reviews
invite.admin3: You can change services, prices and settings
invite.specialist1: You’ll see your own calendar and bookings
invite.specialist2: You can answer your own requests
invite.specialist3: You’ll see your own clients and earnings
invite.declineLead: {name} will be told. To join later you’ll need a new invite.
invite.declineLeadNobody: The business will be told. To join later you’ll need a new invite.

expired.title: The invite has expired
expired.lead: Each invite works for {days} days. The invite {business} sent on {sent} ended on {ended}.
expired.note: Ask the owner to send it again — the new invite will appear here.

empty.title: You don’t have a workspace yet
empty.lead: Open your business: calendar, online booking and a client list — free.
empty.note: Work at a business? Ask the owner to send an invite to your phone number — it will appear here.

opening.title: Opening {business}…
opening.one: We open the workspace you used last.
opening.many: You have {count} workspaces. We open the one you used last; pick another at the top of the left menu.

placeholder.workspaceLead: {level} · {city}. The calendar and the rest of the workspace come with the next parts of the app.
placeholder.setupLead: Setting up a business comes with the next part of the app.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: The address may have a typo, or the page has moved.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.lead: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.
